title: lavandula spica var. vulgaris
intro: Lavandula spica var. vulgaris, commonly known as English Lavender, is a subspecies of the Lavandula plant family, known for its fragrant purple flowers and calming properties. The health benefits of English Lavender include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The plant's therapeutic actions include acting as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic agent, which can help soothe wounds, calm digestive issues, and ease muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of English Lavender include linalool, linalyl acetate, and other volatile oils that contribute to its medicinal and fragrant properties.
